C1611.title: Shenzhen Longhua Police Dismantle Hotel Hidden Camera and Stalking Ring
C1611.summary: In August 2021, as part of the 'Clean Net 2021' operation, Shenzhen Longhua police cracked a personal information infringement case and dismantled a criminal gang. The group illegally installed cameras in hotels to conduct voyeuristic recording, sold access to voyeur video accounts, and offered physical stalking and surveillance services, resulting in the arrest of 10 suspects.

references.title: Illegally Installing Cameras in Hotels, Selling Voyeuristic Video Accounts: Three Arrested
